note: No shipment evidence found in either direction, but this is a tooling limitation rather than proof of absence: volza.com, eximpedia.app and trademo.com all returned HTTP 403, DuckDuckGo (web_search, html and lite endpoints) was unreachable, and ImportKey renders shipment tables client-side so no rows were readable. Per Rule 5 the status is therefore 'unknown', not 'confirmed' and not 'none_found' — the company's own website/catalogue claims were not used as evidence at all. Declared HS 871160 (electric motorcycles/cycles) and PAN AAMCR1370D / Maharashtra were taken from the input and NOT independently verified; no CIN, GSTIN, revenue figure or export volume is asserted here because none is public in the sources reachable. Recommended next step: re-run against a paid Volza/Eximpedia view or the DGFT/IEC and GST portals before assigning any shipment verdict.
